ns2:course.label: Physics of Societal Issues
ns2:course.description: Physics topics and applications relevant in the modern world: energy, quantum mechanics, electricity and magnetism, nuclear physics, waves, light, and outer space. Application to satellites, alternative energy, medical imaging, radiation, nuclear weapons, climate change, and electronics. Emphasis on analytical thinking and the applicability to modern societal issues.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Nat Sci & Tech - Phys Sciences, and Quantitative Reasoning II course.
